text:
maria: Heads up — since ~08:45 UTC we're seeing a spike of 502/504 from hosted inference API (/v1/generate). Error rate up ~6% and latency tail is awful. Rolling back client changes didn't help. Anyone on cache infra?

jen: seeing matching auth failures to memcached in the gateway logs: `ERR: SASL auth failed user=kv-prefix svc=memcached host=cache-03` repeated across many hosts starting 08:44:51.

kyle: pgrafana link: https://grafana.internal/r/xyZ789/cache-auth-failures — big jump at 08:44. Also prefetch queue grew.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-342 — prefetched-kv-auth-failures causing gateway 5xx. Pager oncall: @eng-sre-oncall

eng-sre-oncall: grabbing logs now. Can somebody paste a representative API 502 stack trace?

maria: here is the gateway log snippet from one request:```
[2026-03-17T08:45:03Z] request_id=req_9a2f kv_fetch(memcached,prefix=user:abc) -> ERROR: auth failed; fallback=false; upstream=memcached://cache-03:11211; returning 502
```

jen: config change pushed this morning rotated memcached SASL creds via secrets-manager. Rotation job shows success, but memcached servers logged auth rejects. Possible key mismatch.

kyle: quick repro: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://hosted.redwood/v1/generate -> intermittent 502s. When memcached auth fails gateway returns 502 for generation requests that depend on prefix cache read.

eng-sre-oncall: immediate mitigation: enabling cache-fallback-to-empty (route /v1/generate) to bypass strict cache errors so we return generation from model instead of 502. Pushing now.

maria: noted, enabling fallback reduced 502s to baseline within ~90s. Thanks. We still need root cause — is it secrets rotation mismatch or couch of memcached nodes?

jen: talking to infra: secrets-manager rotated the credential blob but the rolling deploy that consumes the secret didn't restart the memcached cluster; some nodes are reading old creds and rejecting new ones. Looks like staggered rollout + caching of secret in memcached process.

eng-sre-oncall: next steps: 1) full memcached process restart on affected pool (cache-03/04/05) with coordinated maintenance window; 2) validate secret version propagation; 3) add health-check gating to avoid returning 5xx when backend cache auth is failing (keep-open fallback).

kyle: created follow-up ticket: https://work.redwood/tickets/INF-6124 — includes repro steps, logs, and mitigation timeline.

maria: customer impact notes — several hosted customers reported increased latency and some 5xx for 8:44–09:05 UTC, billing unaffected but degraded SLA. I'll draft incident notes once eng-sre confirms restarts. :white_check_mark:

jen: after restart we saw memcached auth errors drop to ~0 and prefetched queue drained. Will CI the restart procedure and add runbook steps for secret rotation.

eng-sre-oncall: marking incident resolved in the morning postmortem. If anyone sees a recurrence ping me directly. Thanks all. :team-heart:
